0022600151.text: The Cleveland Cavaliers, now 3-2 and 2nd in the Central, 1.5 games back, visit the Milwaukee Bucks, who are 1-4, 4th in the Central, 3.5 games back, and 13th in the East. Cleveland is 3-0 at home but 0-2 on the road and is on a one-game losing streak, while Milwaukee is also on a one-game losing streak with a 1-2 home record and an 0-2 road record, and Jaylon Tyson is out for the Cavaliers with an ankle sprain. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and Cleveland won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 123-116 win in Milwaukee on March 17, 2026.
